description: PennyLane-backed Trotter product evolution using qml.TrotterProduct after decomposing matrix terms into Pauli operators.
applicable_hamiltonians: Dense matrix Hamiltonian terms convertible to PennyLane Pauli operators
Local or sparse Hamiltonians suitable for PennyLane workflows
limitations: Input terms must be square Hermitian matrices with power-of-two dimension
Large dense matrices can make Pauli decomposition expensive
Single-term Hamiltonians are handled with exact qml.exp rather than TrotterProduct

order.description: Trotter product order passed to PennyLane.

execution.returns: Approximate time-evolution unitary matrix synthesized through PennyLane.

complexity.gate_count: Depends on number of Pauli terms after decomposition, product formula order, and steps
complexity.circuit_depth: Depends on PennyLane TrotterProduct expansion, product formula order, and steps
complexity.error_scaling: Product-formula error depends on order, step count, simulation time, and commutator structure
